title: Docs + runbook: local smoke (install-from-file + Try It)
description: Write a crisp runbook proving the end-to-end loop: build zip -> install into rznapp -> run Try It scripts -> see stdout/stderr + exported artifacts.

title: Build signed python-tools bundle ZIP (macos_universal)
description: Add build tooling in this repo (or sibling) to package the python-tools extension ZIP with deterministic plugin.json signing, and include the python runtime payload as documented in docs/PYTHON_TOOLS_EXTENSION_PACKAGING.md.

title: Curate Python demo suite and quick starts
Harden DataScience policy for numpy/pandas/matplotlib
description: DS bundle imports work in YOLO/native; DataScience profile in sandboxed engine can break numpy/matplotlib due to import/network/subprocess restrictions. Investigate import allowlist and wrapper execution context; add regression tests.

title: Move rzn-python-worker source out of rznapp
description: Extract the python MCP worker (rzn-python-worker) out of the desktop host repo so authors can build python-tools without cloning rznapp. The worker should depend on pysandbox for secure mode and support YOLO mode via config.

title: CI: Upload python-tools ZIP to R2 and register release in backend
description: Wire CI publishing: upload immutable ZIP artifacts to R2 and call backend admin API to register releases (Option B). Backend will publish a signed catalog consumed by rznapp.
notes: Blocked on backend-6d2.2 (register release) + backend-6d2.3 (publish catalog). Local install-from-file loop is implemented.

title: rznapp-a32.12: publish honest quick_start requirements and normalized output metadata
description: Update the packaged python_sandbox system metadata so each variant carries honest quick_start requirements and explicit output-shape metadata, normalize artifact-oriented quick starts to return renderable image/file result shapes, then build and publish the signed variants through the local-first backend release flow.

title: Production python-tools publish blocked by Cloudflare 1010 at https://rzn.ai
description: Attempting the scoped publisher flow for python-tools 0.2.2 against the repo-mandated production base URL https://rzn.ai failed immediately at POST /publisher/products/:product_id/releases with HTTP 403 and Cloudflare error code 1010. Local publish to http://localhost:8082 succeeded for python-tools, python-tools-system, and python-tools-ds. Resolve the correct production API authority / WAF policy and rerun the production publish contract.

title: Ship demo quick starts in packaged Python metadata
description: Add the curated demo quick starts to system.metadata.yaml for python-tools variants so rebuilt signed bundles surface them in desktop UI.

title: Add Rust data science demo aligned with Python demo suite
description: Follow up on the curated Python demo ladder by adding a Rust-side example that showcases charting, ML, and a public-data workflow without overloading examples/working_demo.rs.

title: Publish python-tools variants via backend Option B (R2 + register + catalog publish)
description: scripts/publish_python_tools_variants.py exists; finish wiring env/secrets in CI and validate end-to-end (upload to R2, POST /admin/plugins/releases, POST /admin/plugins/catalog/publish).

title: Python Tools Extension: Worker + Runtime + Publish (Option B)
description: Ship Python Tools as an installable, signed RZN extension bundle (plugin ZIP) that can be published from this repo and installed into rznapp via the backend-signed catalog (Option B). See docs/PYTHON_TOOLS_EXTENSION_PACKAGING.md for the full plan.
